method: public long hardwoodColumnar() throws IOException { long checksum = 0; try (HardwoodContext context = BenchContext.create(); ParquetFileReader reader = ParquetFileReader.open(inputFile, context); ColumnReaders cols = reader.buildColumnReaders(ColumnProjection.all()).build()) { int columns = WideFileGenerator.COLUMNS; while (cols.nextBatch()) { int n = cols.getRecordCount(); for (int c = 0; c < columns; c++) { float[] values = cols.getColumnReader(c).getFloats(); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { checksum += Float.floatToRawIntBits(values[i]); } } } } return checksum; }
